title: DEA adopts a permanent rule for telemedicine prescribing of controlled substances
proposition: The DEA adopts a permanent final rule for the prescribing of controlled substances by telemedicine without a prior in-person medical evaluation.

title: Accelerated TMS (SNT) trial in bipolar depression meets its primary endpoint
proposition: A randomized controlled trial of SNT or another accelerated TMS protocol in bipolar depression meets its prespecified primary efficacy endpoint.

title: A US health plan covers intravenous ketamine for bipolar depression
proposition: A US health plan or public program publishes a coverage policy that covers intravenous ketamine as medically necessary for bipolar depression.
